race.comment: BORDERFALL (1) improving gelding heading in the right direction. Got off the mark first up in sharp style over this trip at Wyong. Found a fairly strong BM64 with a courageous fourth over 1100m at Wyong when anchored with the 59kg. Gets map favours and should prove too good for this lot. DEE DEE EXPRESS (3) trained locally and will find this more to her liking with the claim. Total forgive from the wide with a fading on pace fifteenth over 1100m at Randwick in Highway class. Winning apprentice goes back on and has the ability to return to form. STROLLIN' BY (8) started as a dominant fav when she dropped sharply in class with a comfortable Super Maiden win over 1100m at Mudgee. Confidence is high and worth plenty of thought. The chances don't end there. AZURE ANGEL (6) has won previously first-up and resumes here after a break of four-and-a-half months. Has a host of gear changes and trialled well.
